title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: federated Copilot connectors read third-party data live through MCP
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing and governance controls are supported, including the updated distinction between blocking a plugin package and blocking its shared MCP server. One minor correction should acknowledge older preview documentation that described a different tenant default; current documentation leaves initial publisher selections unstated.
